Help {npc:Zalamon} and the lizard rebels of Zao overthrow the corrupted dragon emperor. You infiltrate northern Zao hidden in a crate, reactivate teleports, kill The Keeper, assemble an ancient sceptre in Deeper Banuta, enter Razachai, invade the palace, free a sleeping dragon through its dream and destroy the emperor's four incarnations and the mutated Zalamon himself. At the end you receive lots of gold and treasures, a draken armour of your choice, the Wayfarer outfit and permanent access to Razachai.
Help Zalamon in his fight against the corrupted emperor.
Level 80 to pass the expertise door in mission 8 (130+ recommended).
{wiki:The New Frontier Quest} until you receive the mission *Mortal Kombat* (it doesn't need to be complete).
{wiki:Children of the Revolution Quest} completed, plus the daily task *Zzuppliezz*.
{wiki:The Ape City Quest} until you have started mission 9 (access to Banuta).
Two players for mission 1 (levers). It is possible solo, but it is very tight.
For the bosses of missions 10 and 11 it is strongly recommended to go with a team.
for Zalamon to make the crate (mission 1)
80 oz of free capacity to carry the {item:Marked Crate} in mission 1
15,000 gp for the three parts of the sceptre (mission 4)
Instead of the Shovel and the Pick you can bring one of the {wiki:Secret Agent Tools}
Plenty of potions and runes for mission 8 onwards: once you enter the palace you can't go back to restock until you finish mission 9
Your choice of one: {item:Elite Draken Helmet}, {item:Royal Draken Mail}, {item:Royal Scale Robe} or {item:Merudri Scale Mail}
Access (and use of the teleports) to {wiki:Razachai}, the {wiki:Rebel Camp} and the {wiki:Razachai/Inner Sanctum|Inner Sanctum}
Northern Zao (Northern Zao Plantations, Souleater Mountains, Ghastly Dragon Lair)
Mission 1 (Catering the Lion's Den): you enter the Lion's Den disguised with the {item:Marked Crate}.
Mission 1: first arrival via the Lion's Den.
Blue flame between Chartan's room and the Muggy Plains
After mission 2 (First Contact), when you reactivate the teleport and report to {npc:Chartan}.
The four deepest floors of Deeper Banuta
Permanent access once you finish the quest.
Teleports between Razachai, the Rebel Camp and the Inner Sanctum
Count on about 12 hours in total. Each mission can be done in a different session.
Always bring a {item:Shovel}, {item:Rope}, {item:Rake}, {item:Pick} and {item:Obsidian Knife}: you need them right from the first missions.
Before mission 8 fill your backpack with potions and runes: from the palace on you can't leave to buy supplies without a {item:Scale of Corruption} until you finish mission 9.

On the bosses of missions 10 and 11, {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Walls}, {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bombs}, {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bombs} and {item:Sudden Death Rune|SDs} help a lot: most creatures are weak to energy and none is very strong against death.
Zalamon wants you to infiltrate northern Zao through a lizard maintenance tunnel, hidden inside a marked crate.

{npc:Zalamon} is at the far **east** of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, 1 floor below ground. To get there, take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch} (far below Kazordoon) or {npc:Gurbasch} (8 floors below Cormaya), with {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:yes}. In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the lift takes you to the surface of the mountain. Follow the passage **east**, going down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/crates), until you come out on the Zao Steppe. Then cross the steppe **east** to Zalamon.
Exit of the mountain passage (entrance to the Zao Steppe)

To go back to Farmine, do the route in reverse: climb the mountain on the passage (with {spell:Levitate}) and head **west** to the lift. On the steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon ({key:kazordoon}) or to Cormaya ({key:cormaya}).
Go to {npc:Zalamon}'s hideout and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} twice. He asks you for 3 {item:Nail|nails} and 1 {item:Wood|piece of wood} to build a disguise.

With the 3 {item:Nail|Nails} and the {item:Wood} in your inventory, go back to {npc:Zalamon}. Say {key:mission} and {key:yes}, then {key:crate} and {key:yes}. He creates the {item:Marked Crate} and marks two spots on your map: the entrance to the maintenance tunnels and the resistance hideout in the north.
The crate is quite heavy: you need 80 oz of free capacity. If you lose it, Zalamon keeps the material and can make another one ({key:build}).

Use the teleport to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}, in the north of the Zao Steppe, and go to the marked spot in the east of the Muggy Plains (north-east of the village with {creature:Lizard Zaogun|Lizard Zaoguns}). Use the {item:Shovel} on the hole and you enter the **Lion's Den**.
Teleport to the Muggy Plains (north of the Zao Steppe)
Hole to the Lion's Den (use the shovel)
Get past the defences in disguise

With the {item:Marked Crate} as a disguise, advance through the tunnel without being seen:
- **Doors with {item:Observation Slit|observation slits}:** you can only pass when the slit is **closed**.
- **Five {creature:Lizard Tunnel Guard|Lizard Tunnel Guards}:** hug the wall and stay as far as possible from light sources. Lower the *ambient light* in the options to see the lit areas better.
- **Do not speak** in the Local channel near them.
Door with an observation slit: only pass when it is closed
Path through the tunnel to the stairs
If you are discovered, you are teleported to a prison where {npc:Zumtah} is. See the next step to get out.
If you are caught: leaving Zumtah's prison

Talk to {npc:Zumtah} and say exactly this sequence: {key:hi}, {key:exit}, {key:no}, {key:yes}, {key:exit}, {key:no}, {key:yes}, {key:exit}, {key:no}, {key:yes}, {key:278}, {key:exit}, {key:exit}, {key:exit}, {key:exit}. He turns you into a {creature:Lancer Beetle}; go to the {item:Hole (Earth)|hole} and you are teleported to the start of the Lion's Den, where you get the crate back. Try again.
If you get caught again later, just say {key:hi} and {key:exit}: he transforms you right away.

After the defences you reach some stairs. **Downstairs** there are three switches that turn off the lights upstairs; **upstairs** there is another switch that moves a wall.
1. One player goes down and pulls the first two switches.
2. At the same time, the other goes up and pulls the switch on the upper floor to open the wall.
3. The one downstairs passes the wall and pulls the 3rd switch, which turns off the last light.
4. The one upstairs passes the last guard, on the left.
The lights stay off for **30 seconds**; the wall only stays open for **10 seconds**.
It is possible to do it solo: after turning off the lights, run back through the dark area to the wall in under 10 seconds.

Go up and you come out in a watchtower in the east of {wiki:Northern Zao}. The first sqm are **Protection Zone**. The quick way back south only becomes available after mission 2 (the blue flame south of {npc:Chartan}, which leads to the Muggy Plains).

Follow the road **west** to the mountain where the rebels' hideout is (spot marked on your minimap). On the way you face high-class lizards, {creature:Mutated Rat|Mutated Rats}, {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats}, {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers} and {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}. Inside, talk to the leader, {npc:Chartan}.

{npc:Chartan} needs you to reactivate the teleport to the Muggy Plains, which is in the ancient temple beneath the hideout. You need a {item:Rake}, {item:Obsidian Knife}, {item:Shovel} and {item:Pick} (or one of the {wiki:Secret Agent Tools} instead of the shovel and pick).
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:Zalamon}, then {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you the key to the temple complex entrance.
Go down the stairs and enter the temple. Go to the room furthest **south** and use the {item:Shovel} on the soil to get {item:Sacred Earth}.
Go to the room with mud and use the {item:Rake} on the mud to get a {item:Lump of Clay}.
Combine the {item:Lump of Clay} with the {item:Sacred Earth} (use one on the other) to get a {item:Lump of Sacred Clay}.
Go to the room with the table and use the {item:Pick} on the crack to get {item:Unworked Sacred Wood}.
Use the {item:Obsidian Knife} on the wood to get a {item:Sacred Bowl}.
Use the {item:Lump of Sacred Clay} on the bowl to get a {item:Sacred Bowl of Purification}.
Go to the room full of water and use the bowl on the water to get a {item:Bowl with Sacred Water}.
Go back to the first room and use the bowl on the brazier (fire basin) to get {item:Sacred Coal}.
Go to the last room and use the {item:Sacred Coal} on the water next to the {item:Jade Basin}. The teleport is reactivated.
Go back to {npc:Chartan} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He sends you to {npc:Zalamon}. From now on you can go **south** of Chartan and step on the blue flame to return to the Muggy Plains.

Use the blue flame to return to the Muggy Plains, go back to the Zao Steppe through the teleport you arrived by and head **east** to {npc:Zalamon}. Say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Flask of Plant Poison} to poison the emperor's garden plants and attract **The Keeper**.
Go down through the garden hole

Return to the rebels' hideout in northern Zao through the connection you reactivated in mission 2 (Zalamon confirms that you have a connection to the hideout). The garden is south-east of the rebels' hideout. Find the hole and go down. You reach a cave with {creature:Brimstone Bug|Brimstone Bugs}, {creature:Wailing Widow|Wailing Widows} and {creature:Lancer Beetle|Lancer Beetles}.

Fight your way down a few floors to the big maze-like floor. Always stay on the **west** side of the cave and make your way to the stairs in the **south-west**. Go down them: you reach a huge empty room.
Look for the {item:Giant Dreadcoil|Giant Dreadcoils} (purple plants) and use the poison flask on them until it is empty. **The Keeper** appears at the far **north** of the room.
{creature:The Keeper} looks like a {creature:Serpent Spawn}: it doesn't hit very hard, but it has tons of health. It is best to go with other players; solo is possible but you use a lot of supplies.

In the room there are several poison fields. The one with the **brightest** colour deals 8000 damage to the Keeper when it steps on it. After that the "active" field changes and you have to lure it to another one.

**Use the corpse** of the Keeper to get {item:The Tail of the Keeper}. Fight your way out of the cave the same way: go up the stairs and the floors to the garden hole and use the {item:Rope} to return to the surface.
Don't forget to use the corpse: without the tail you can't hand in the mission.
Hand in the proof to Zalamon
Go back to {npc:Zalamon} (blue flame south of {npc:Chartan} to the Muggy Plains, teleport to the Zao Steppe and then **east**) and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.

Zalamon wants an ancient sceptre ({item:Snake Sceptre}) hidden beneath {wiki:Deeper Banuta}. On each floor there is a {npc:Ghost of a Priest} who sells you a {item:Sceptre Part} for 5000 gp. On the 4th floor you assemble the sceptre at the altar.
Talk to {npc:Zalamon}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He asks you for the sceptre split into three parts: a *shaft*, a *cusp* and an *emerald*.

Deeper Banuta is beneath {wiki:Banuta}, north of **Port Hope**. From Zao: on the Farmine steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}, 110 gp); go up to the surface in Cormaya and, at the north port, {npc:Pemaret} takes you to Edron ({key:edron}, 20 gp); in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Port Hope ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}, 150 gp). From Port Hope head **north** through the Tiquanda jungle to Banuta (if you have enough rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}'s ferry takes you straight to Banuta). In Banuta go down to floor -2 and enter the {wiki:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefield} that leads to the first floor of Deeper Banuta (access from {wiki:The Ape City Quest}).
In Banuta and on the first floors below there are many apes ({creature:Sibang|Sibangs}, {creature:Merlkin|Merlkins}, {creature:Kongra|Kongras}).

Bring **15,000 gp**. Go to the Deeper Banuta quest area and follow the path down. Down to floor -4 you meet {creature:Medusa|Medusas}, {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns}, {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}. On each floor, go to the ghost first and only then move on to the next floor.
Path on floor -4 to the new area

On floor -5 the path goes through, in this order, {creature:Centipede|Centipedes}, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns}, {creature:Medusa|Medusas}, {creature:Acid Blob|Acid Blobs}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems}, {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals}, {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}, {creature:Eternal Guardian|Eternal Guardians} and {creature:Hydra|Hydras}. Talk to the {npc:Ghost of a Priest}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You pay 5000 gp and receive a part of the sceptre.
Path on floor -5: first to the ghost, then to the stairs to the next floor

On floor -6 there are {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns}, {creature:Medusa|Medusas}, {creature:Eternal Guardian|Eternal Guardians} and possibly lured {creature:Hydra|Hydras}. Talk to the ghost: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} (5000 gp).
Path on floor -6: first to the ghost, then to the stairs to the next floor

On floor -7 there are, in order, {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns}, {creature:Medusa|Medusas}, {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}, {creature:Eternal Guardian|Eternal Guardians}, {creature:Hydra|Hydras}, 2 {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, 2 {creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns}, 1 {creature:Phantasm} and 1 {creature:Ghastly Dragon}. Talk to the ghost: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} (5000 gp). You now have the {item:Sceptre Part (Cusp)|Cusp}, the {item:Sceptre Part (Emerald)|Emerald} and the {item:Sceptre Part (Shaft)|Shaft}.
Floor -7: once you have the 3 parts of the Snake Sceptre, go down to the next floor

Go down to floor -8 ({creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns}, {creature:Medusa|Medusas}, {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}, {creature:Eternal Guardian|Eternal Guardians}, {creature:Hydra|Hydras}). Head to the altar and use it (the switch) to join the three parts into a {item:Snake Sceptre}.
Floor -8: follow the line to the altar and join the 3 parts into a single item. Careful: there are many creatures near the altar
There are many creatures near the altar. Each player has to activate the switch themselves to update the quest log; you can't make the sceptre for someone else.

Fight your way back up the same way to the first floor of Deeper Banuta and leave through the portal at the start: it takes you to the **second floor of Banuta** (floor -2). Climb the stairs to the surface and return to **Port Hope**. There {npc:Charles} takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 150 gp); in Edron {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Cormaya ({key:cormaya}, 20 gp); go down to the steamship 8 floors below Cormaya and {npc:Gurbasch} takes you to Farmine ({key:farmine}). Then go up the elevator and cross the Zao Steppe to Zalamon, as at the start.
Go back to {npc:Zalamon} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Now you have to enter the city of Razachai, using papers forged by the rebels.
To start this mission you have to complete the daily task of the {wiki:Children of the Revolution Quest}.
If you take the weekly task *Strike* before asking for this mission, you have to finish it first. Only take the daily task *Supplies*.
Say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Zalamon}. He sends you to the city entrance and says the papers have already been sent.

Go to the rebels' hideout in northern Zao (through the connection you reactivated in mission 2). From the hideout, go out onto the grey road and follow it **south-west**. You will face many monsters: {creature:Brimstone Bug|Brimstone Bugs}, {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}, {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires} and a few {creature:Lancer Beetle|Lancer Beetles}.
Talk to the {npc:Gate Guardian}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He lets you in.
After you enter once, the Gate Guardian won't let you in again. If you help someone with this mission, you will have to fight your way back to the Rebel Camp.

Inside the city there are no more monsters in this mission, but some {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest|Lizard Dragon Priests} and {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires} can attack you through the windows. Head **west** to the big green building where {npc:Zlak} is.
Talk to {npc:Zlak}, inside the city: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He asks you to eliminate four high-ranking officials.
Kill 4 {creature:Lizard Magistratus}. They are all inside the building where Zlak is. You can see how many you have already killed in the quest log.
Beneath Zlak there is a teleport that leads to {npc:Chartan}'s room (where you can buy supplies). To return to Zlak, use the blue flame on the **right** side in Chartan's room.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Zlak}. He asks you to kill at least six nobles.

Kill 6 {creature:Lizard Noble|Lizard Nobles}. They are outside the ministry building, on the higher floors. You see the count in the quest log. You use fewer supplies if you find a respawn and kill all 6 there.

You are going to attack the palace through the old escape tunnel. Bring plenty of supplies (depending on the team size): until you have a {item:Scale of Corruption} you can't leave to restock and return to the sleeping dragon.
Say {key:mission} twice to {npc:Zlak}. He sends you through the escape tunnel that leaves from the abandoned basement in the north of the ministry.
Go down to the basement and walk **north**. Keep going down: you are teleported to the palace.

In the palace you face lots of Drakens on every floor, starting here. The place is huge: you have to reach the lowest floor (-5). On the lower floors there are also {creature:Wyrm|Wyrms}, {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns} and a {creature:Demon}. Along the way there is an expertise door that requires level 80.
Reach {npc:Zizzle}'s Protection Zone and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. You are safe here, but you still can't leave: the teleport back doesn't work yet.
To reach the emperor you need the key kept in the mind of a sleeping dragon. You will "travel" through his dream using only words.
Receive the potion and the sheet
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Zizzle}. You receive an {item:Interdimensional Potion} and a {item:Scribbled Sheet of Paper} with the magic word.
Enter the **south-east** teleport. The room is Protection Zone. Walk **north** to {npc:A Sleeping Dragon}.

Drink the {item:Interdimensional Potion}, say {key:hi} to the dragon and then {key:SOLOSARASATIQUARIUM}. You enter the dream: you don't need to move, you "travel" with words ({key:look}, directions, {key:take}, {key:use}, {key:help}).
Say the words **exactly in this order**. Closing the conversation window with the dragon does **not** reset your progress.
Map of the rooms inside the dragon's dream
You take the *stand*; the great gate opens
You go through the gate to the east
You pick up the model of little houses
You go back through the gate to the west
You reach the crimson sea of stones
You put the *attachment* in the *socket*; the gate opens and you see something shiny
You pass the gate to a dune
You throw the model into the water; you hear a noise to the west
You go back via the dune and the gate
You return to the sea of rubies
You go through the open gate to the west
You see the statue of Bastesh with a sapphire
You go back east, to the plateau
You put the mirror on the *stand*: the black creature dissolves and you wake up

If you get lost, say {key:east}, {key:south}, {key:south}, {key:east}, {key:south}, {key:west}, {key:north} to return to the plateau (the start) from wherever you are. Items you have already picked up stay with you; if the dragon says "Take what?" when you try to pick one up again, ignore it and carry on. The quest log shows how many items you already have.
Once awake, say to {npc:A Sleeping Dragon}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He shares with you the key to pass through the gate and gives you the {item:Spiritual Charm}.

After mission 9 you can use the teleport in the **bottom-left** corner of {npc:Zizzle}'s room to return to the {creature:Lizard Magistratus} building in the centre of Razachai (you appear behind a sealed door, just north of the teleport to {npc:Chartan}) and buy supplies.
To go back from Chartan/Razachai to Zizzle's room you need a {item:Scale of Corruption} each time.
You have to realign the four crystals that transmit the emperor's will, by killing his four incarnations.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Zizzle}. You receive a {item:Replica of the Sceptre}.
Put the {item:Replica of the Sceptre} on a hotkey.

Go back to the dragon room and walk **north** of {npc:A Sleeping Dragon}, to the big door: you are teleported to another room. The next teleport takes you to the main room, full of {creature:Draken Abomination|Draken Abominations}, {creature:Undead Dragon|Undead Dragons} and {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons}.
Main room of the four teleports
{item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Walls} help a lot: most of these creatures are weak to energy and immune to death.

There are 4 teleports that lead to the emperor's incarnations: {creature:Fury of the Emperor}, {creature:Wrath of the Emperor}, {creature:Scorn of the Emperor} and {creature:Spite of the Emperor}. Start with the **north-west** teleport and go **clockwise**. In each room:
1. Use the sceptre on the pillar to summon the boss.
2. Kill the boss: it turns into a dust (similar to magic sulphur).
3. **Quickly** use the sceptre on the remains.
After the last boss you are teleported to mission 11.

**All** team members have to use their replica on the remains of each boss. If the boss has already been summoned by another team, you can't enter the teleport: wait for them to finish. Check the quest log after each use.
Talk to the Awareness of the Emperor
The teleport takes you to the NPC {npc:Awareness of the Emperor}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Your new mission is to kill Zalamon.

Pass the teleport and walk to the centre of the room. Zalamon appears first as {creature:Snake God Essence}, then {creature:Snake Thing}, then {creature:Lizard Abomination} and finally {creature:Mutated Zalamon}. Kill the four forms and **use the sceptre on the final corpse**.

{item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bombs} and {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bombs} help, but the bosses can switch target to whoever throws them. {item:Sudden Death Rune|SDs} work well to finish them off: none is very strong against death.
After you kill Mutated Zalamon you can no longer enter {npc:Zalamon}'s room or ask him for tasks. The Children of the Revolution daily and weekly tasks are now given by {npc:Chartan}.
Go back to the {npc:Awareness of the Emperor} and say {key:mission}. He tells you to talk to the magistrate Izsh in the ministry.

{npc:Izsh} is two floors up, in the {creature:Lizard Magistratus} area. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He "deducts" fines from the promised reward and tells you that what is left is in one of the old supply cellars.

Go down to the cellar and collect the rewards: the {item:Dragon Backpack}, the {item:Jewelled Backpack} and **one** of your choice among {item:Elite Draken Helmet}, {item:Royal Draken Mail}, {item:Royal Scale Robe} and {item:Merudri Scale Mail}. Then open the wardrobe to receive the Wayfarer outfit.
You can only choose **one** of the four armour pieces: think carefully before opening.
Dragon Backpack, Jewelled Backpack, an armour of your choice and the Wayfarer outfit

With the quest done you can use the teleports between Razachai, the Rebel Camp and the Inner Sanctum. To go back to Farmine: in the basement beneath {npc:Zlak} enter the teleport that leads to {npc:Chartan}'s room; there, the blue flame **south** of Chartan takes you to the Muggy Plains; in the Muggy Plains go back to the Zao Steppe through the teleport you arrived by and head **south-west** to the mountain pass. Climb it with {spell:Levitate} and go **west** to the Farmine elevator.
Exit of the mountain passage (entrance to the Zao Steppe)
When you finish you have permanent access to Razachai, the Rebel Camp and the Inner Sanctum, including the teleports between them.
In mission 4 each character has to assemble their own sceptre at the altar on floor -8.
